verdict.rationale: Stripe Connect's own docs say integrations establish a webhook endpoint to listen for Connect events, which is a registrable outbound HTTP callback mechanism a programmatic consumer can receive. A hands-on community user separately praises the Connect webhooks. missing for 10: in-depth evidence of the event-type catalog and per-event subscription filtering, and documentation of delivery guarantees such as signature verification and retries.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: All Connect integrations should establish a webhook endpoint to listen for Connect events.
The webhooks are great and the oauth flow is super simple too.
